args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring (and `tests/test_money.py`, per FIN-212) requiring banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly test run to fail.

## Change
- Replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
